CustomField.description: The upsert key for the nightly sync. UNIQUE on this object - deliberately the opposite of Case.Yardi_AR_Id__c, which must NOT be unique because closed Cases accumulate for a tenant who re-delinquents. Length 50 matches the already-deployed Case field so the denormalised copy can never truncate.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Yardi’s identifier for this receivable. System-managed - do not change it or the next sync will create a duplicate row.
CustomField.label: Yardi AR Id
